Lead source: inbound self-serve signup via quickstart.

Summary: SMB analytics startup building conversational insights for merchants. Interested in hosted API only for now — want lowest friction, predictable cost. Early discovery; technical eval by engineering lead (CTO: Hannah Li).

Product / workload details: chat-first product for merchant support + contextual recommendations. Also embeddings for similarity search of product catalogs and reranking for search results. Target avg p99 latency ~200-300ms for short chat turns; throughput modest (100-200 reqs/min peak), cost-sensitive — trying to decide: cheaper 7B Mistral/Qwen vs higher-quality Llama2-13B (quantized) for tricky domain-specific responses.

Model selection discussion (from calls & emails):
- They ran quick samples on Mistral-instruct-7B (cheapest, good at instruction following) and liked speed.
- Curious about Qwen-7B variants (cost + multi-lingual support) — asked about tokenization differences and embedding compatibility.
- Concerned about hallucination on Mistral vs Llama2 13B: "We get better factuality on 13B but cost doubles", quote from CTO.
- Asked for guidance: when to pick 7B vs 13B, when to use quantized 13B, tradeoffs on latency vs cost vs quality. Requested benchmark comparing top-of-queue 7B variants vs 13B on their sample prompts.

Security / compliance: basic SSO (SAML) required; SOC2 expected within 6-12 months. Want audit logs for API keys and usage. No data residency constraint currently.

Commercial: SMB pricing sensitivity. Estimated ARR target for first year ~$5k-12k if POC succeeds. Interested in trial credits to test 13B quantized path and routing/fallback to cheaper models.
